user.title: Find a ski resort
user.description: Search OpenSkiMap for a resort by name. No API key needed — weather comes from the free Open-Meteo service.

data_description.query: Type part of the resort name, e.g. Vail, Whistler, Chamonix.

select.title: Choose the ski area
select.description: Pick the matching OpenSkiMap ski area. Its lift slug is filled in automatically when known.

error.no_results: No ski areas matched that name. Try fewer letters or clear the country filter.

abort.already_configured: This ski area is already configured.
abort.area_not_found: That ski area is no longer in the bundled list. Please search again.

init.title: Ski resort options
init.description: Weather is free via Open-Meteo. Optionally add live lift status (self-hosted Liftie or a RapidAPI key), a RapidAPI snow-forecast, and the keyless NWS weather alerts and avalanche danger sources.

data_description.enable_alerts: Add a binary sensor for active US National Weather Service alerts (winter storm warnings, etc.) at the resort. Keyless; US only.
data_description.enable_avalanche: Add a sensor with the avalanche.org danger rating for the resort's forecast zone. Keyless; US and participating international centers.
data_description.liftie_base_url: Just the host and port of your self-hosted Liftie instance (its server root) — not the full /api/resort/... path. When set, lift status comes from Liftie instead of RapidAPI — completely free.
data_description.rapidapi_key: Enables skiapi lift status and the RapidAPI snow-forecast. Leave blank to stay fully free.
data_description.forecast_resort: The snow-forecast resort name (needs a RapidAPI key), e.g. Vail or Beaver-Creek.
data_description.forecast_interval_hours: How often to refresh the metered RapidAPI snow source, independent of the main update interval. Reported depths change ~daily, so a large value (default 12h ≈ 60 calls/month) keeps you inside free-tier quotas.
data_description.webcam_url: A direct link to a resort webcam still image (JPG/PNG/WebP), shown as an image entity. You can also paste an OpenSnow cam page URL (opensnow.com/location/.../cams/ID) and it's converted automatically. Some resorts block hotlinking.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
